# KPEX

KPEX is a parasitic extraction tool for [KLayout](https://klayout.org).

There are multiple engines supported:

- `FasterCap` (requires [`FasterCap`](https://github.com/iic-jku/FasterCap) installation)
- MAGIC wrapper (requires [MAGIC](https://github.com/RTimothyEdwards/magic) installation)
- 2.5D engine (**under development**)

Check out the [documentation](doc/doc.qmd) for more information.

## Install

`python3 -m pip install kpex`

After that, you should be able to run `kpex --help`.

::: {.callout-caution}
The `kpex` PyPI package contains neither [`FasterCap`](https://github.com/iic-jku/FasterCap) nor [MAGIC](https://github.com/RTimothyEdwards/magic).
To be able to run these engines, the binaries for these tools must be installed separately beforehand.
Check out the [installation documentation](doc/doc.qmd#sec-intro-installation) for more information.
:::
